title: राजनीतिक वित्त व्यवस्थापनः निर्वाचन सुधारको अवसर {Political Finance Management: Opportunity for Electoral Reform}
nepali: यो छोटो लेखमा राजनीतिक वित्तकाबारेको सामान्य बुझाई र अर्थ, राजनीतिक वित्त व्यवस्थापनको क्रममा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय र नेपालको अभ्यास, खास गरी निर्वाचनको क्रममा निर्वाचन गराउने निकाय, सरकार, सुरक्षा निकाय एवं दल वा उम्मेदवारबाट हुने खर्चको प्रवृत्ति; दल र निर्वाचनको खर्चका लागि हुने अपारदर्शी आम्दानीका स्रोत तथा खर्चले निम्त्याएका विकृति; यसको व्यवस्थापनका लागि भए–गरेका प्रयास तथा तिनबाट देखिएका चुनौती, आदि विषयकाबारेमा चर्चा गरिनुका अतिरिक्त यसमा सुधारका लागि प्रणाली, प्रक्रिया, संरचना, व्यवस्थापन र क्षमता विस्तारलगायतका क्षेत्रसँग सम्बन्धित केही सुझावहरू प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । This short article appraises the general understanding and meaning of political finance and the international and Nepalese practice in the management of political finance, and assess the trends in expenditure incurred by election bodies, government, security agencies and parties or candidates during the election, and perversions caused by opaque sources of income and expenses of political parties and election expenses. It then assesses the efforts made to manage them and the challenges posed by them, and, based on that, suggests reforms in the system, process, structure, management, and capacity expansion for the management of political finance.
american_english: In this short article, in addition to discussing subjects such as the general understanding and meaning of political finance, international and Nepalese practice in political finance management, particularly trends in expenditure by electoral management bodies, the government, security agencies, and parties or candidates during elections; distortions brought about by opaque sources of income and expenditure for party and electoral expenses; and the efforts made toward its management along with the challenges emerging from them, several recommendations related to areas including system, process, structure, management, and capacity expansion are presented for reform in this regard.
british_english: In this short article, in addition to discussing subjects such as the general understanding and meaning of political finance, international and Nepalese practice in political finance management, particularly trends in expenditure by electoral bodies, the government, security agencies, and parties or candidates during elections; distortions brought about by non-transparent sources of income and expenditure for party and electoral costs; and the efforts made towards its management along with the challenges emerging from them, several recommendations relating to areas including system, process, structure, management, and capacity expansion are put forward for reform in this regard.
